 On election day people in the Portland area can take a bus to the polls for free.
 Also read : 'I want to be heard': Maine voters cast early ballots with 2 weeks until Election Day 
 Greater Portland Metro will offer free rides on Tuesday, November 3rd, no matter which route riders are taking or where they're going.
 By removing the fare, the metro hopes to help ensure people can make it to the polls on election day.
